name: Eclipse Direct
summary:
Eclipse Direct is the direct-to-fan music platform. Discover independent artists, follow the creators you love, and stream their releases in a 2D panel anywhere in Horizon.

- Discover trending creators and new releases
- Stream free tracks and everything in your Library
- Follow artists to see their posts, videos and updates
- Chat with AI versions of artists
- Browse the marketplace of music, merch and tickets
